card.name: Inside long words, before the next piece
card.fires_on: Fires partway through a longer word, just before the next piece is spelled out, such as bronchod-il-ator, adjud-ication or sol-ute. It also appears in a few split words like Dosage and A-dministration.

modes.label: Medical terms split in the middle
modes.description: The marked piece sits inside a long medical word, and the rest of the word follows.
modes.example: A beta 2 agonist (bronchod<<il>>ator) should be made available.

modes.label: Section names and other split words
modes.description: The marked piece begins a later part of a word or heading, such as Administration or articular.

card.writes: It adds little beyond a weak push toward short letter pieces that continue a word.
card.plain: It lights up in the middle of a long word that is split into pieces, such as bronchodilator, and expects the rest of the word to follow.
